imp.intent: Architect Eng Ready waitlist read for Operator notify. GET /admin/invite/waitlist hosted-only (same gate as other admin/invite routes). Same Bearer OPEN_UX_ADMIN_TOKEN as approve. JSON {items:[{email, created_at}]} newest first from waitlist table only. No tokens/keys/hashes/audit.content. Approve stays POST /admin/invite/approve; no auto-approve. No admin HTML/UI, no OAuth, no UNS-44, no webhooks, no email send, no merge. Base master.
imp.subtitle: cited UX rules agents audit against / shared cited guidelines
imp.layout: packages/mcp (Python FastMCP); catalog/ (JSON+schema stub); clients/claude (thin plugin); packs/; docs/
imp.tools: list_guidelines; get_guideline; audit(target.type html|jsx|description). Hybrid C, no server LLM. reasons[] = catalog pass_when/fail_when + guideline_id.
imp.catalog: Schema-valid empty guidelines.json. jobs[]/patterns[] empty. Soft 100KB / hard 256KB. UNS-44 ×3 not invented here.
imp.auth: Hosted: POST /invite/request email → waitlist; GET /admin/invite/waitlist Bearer OPEN_UX_ADMIN_TOKEN → {items:[{email, created_at}]} newest first; POST /admin/invite/approve Bearer OPEN_UX_ADMIN_TOKEN → inv_ token; POST /invite/redeem → uxmcp_ once. 401 missing/wrong admin bearer. 400 if not hosted. 401 on /mcp without key. Stdio: no auth, no invite. Approve unchanged.
imp.privacy: Waitlist GET returns email + created_at only. Never persist audit.content. Keys and invite tokens hashed at rest; not in waitlist payload. Logs by key_hash. Email waitlist/issue/revoke only. Telemetry: callers, tool mix, verdicts, rule ids, target type. Retention 30d. Account delete wipes keys+logs. Self-host telemetry off.
imp.deploy: Dockerfile + fly.toml + railway.toml. README how-to. OPEN_UX_PEPPER, OPEN_UX_ADMIN_TOKEN, OPEN_UX_PUBLIC_URL. GET /admin/invite/waitlist documented next to POST /admin/invite/approve in DEPLOY.md. SQLite on OPEN_UX_DATA_DIR only. No live URL in this PR.
imp.claude: displayName Open UX; skill pointer connect→key→list→one audit; no duplicated rule bodies; Thursday = URL+key in client settings.
imp.tests: admin waitlist empty {items:[]}; after request_invite email + ISO created_at newest first; 401 without/wrong bearer; no uxmcp_/inv_/hashes/audit.content in waitlist JSON; 400 when not hosted; existing request/approve/redeem/burn and unauthorized 401 still pass.
imp.held: PR open. Do not merge. Hold for Architect review.
